name: BuildMap
mission: Make software construction visible: show what each piece does, what is actually connected, what is still missing, and how every verified piece moves the system toward the intended outcome.

components.name: Intent recovery
components.purpose: Start from whatever intent evidence exists — README, docs, manifest, or eventually an interview — without blocking the map.
components.contributes: Keeps the build focused on what the project is actually trying to accomplish.

components.name: Repository scanner
components.purpose: Discover code files, planned components, imports, gaps, and current evidence states.
components.contributes: Turns source code into the living set of puzzle pieces.

components.name: Live map server
components.purpose: Continuously rescan a local folder or GitHub clone and expose its current map state.
components.contributes: Makes progress visible while the software is being built instead of after the fact.

components.name: Interactive visualizer
components.purpose: Render the project as a navigable machine with connections, proof states, and small visuals that explain each piece.
components.contributes: Lets a human spot gaps, understand progress, and see why a file matters at a glance.

components.name: Verification evidence
components.purpose: Verify the scanner and intent recovery behavior so higher proof states are earned rather than decorative.
components.contributes: Prevents BuildMap from confusing 'exists on disk' with 'actually proven to work.'
